summary: Frozen cycle-08 package assembled for independent H2 audit. It preserves actual H1/H2 probes, original E1201 first-failure scripts and logs plus explicitly post-finish diagnostic qualification, E1203 red/green/controller logs and source before/after, H2 R1203 review, canonical E1204 stdout/site log/receipt, native receipts and epoch-00–03 bundles, and current root-owned browser-attempt records. The E1205 native state capture is historical while packaging was running and is not live dispatch authority. Exact product freeze remains controller.mjs SHA-256 8faad923a2e4721f1cc1059f902c54f97759ef32b57d36fe4fa8523205011a0b and controller.test.mjs SHA-256 1150f43987bf79a5eb82936e0ee6100852f8f29388b239d14849ac08a0fbad62. No source, docs, Git refs, build outputs, or publication payload were changed during packaging. The package identifies one concrete source-derived registration draft-retention hypothesis as unexecuted, with passwords explicitly excluded from state and evidence. H2 audit is the next gate; root retains continuation and connected publication authority.
